blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving use chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to guide action generation, but incur substantial memory and computational costs. We study structured pruning for these models, focusing on preserving both scene understanding and trajectory prediction. Our analysis of Taylor importance in Alpamayo-1.5-10B shows that reasoning and trajectory objectives assign different importance to the same vision-language model (VLM) structures. In the action expert, MLP channels exhibit more stable importance rankings across denoising steps than query heads, and a small fraction of channels accounts for most of the measured importance. Based on these findings, we propose MoOP, which combines importance ranks from both objectives for VLM pruning and aggregates stepwise importance to select a fixed subset of expert MLP channels. At 24.0% total parameter reduction, VLM-only pruning with MoOP performs comparably to or slightly better than the strongest baselines in driving, while retaining 94.0% of the dense model's LingoQA score, far above all other methods. At a higher reduction of 30.0%, MoOP degrades much less than every other method, as it is the only one whose reasoning does not collapse. Removing 93.75% of expert MLP channels increases total parameter reduction to 39.4%, with nearly unchanged open-loop errors relative to VLM-only pruning and competitive closed-loop performance. The resulting model achieves a 1.37x end-to-end inference speedup and 36.6% lower peak memory than the dense model, without post-pruning fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 用于自主驱动的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型用于引导动作生成的思维链(CoT)推理,但产生大量的内存和计算成本. 我们为这些模型研究结构化的钻探, 重点是保持场景理解和轨迹预测。 我们对泰勒在阿尔帕马约-1.5-10B中的重要性的分析表明,推理和轨迹目标对相同的视觉语言模型结构具有不同的重要性。 在动作专家中,MLP频道在调试步骤上显示比查询头更稳定的重要性排名,一小部分频道占了所测量的重要程度. 根据这些调查结果,我们提议采用 " 业务程序 " ,将VLM穿透目标中的重要性等级与逐步综合的重要性结合起来,以选择一个固定的MLP专家渠道子集。 在总参数减少24.0%时,只有VLM与MOOP进行比对或略优于驾驶中最强的基线,同时保留了密度模型LingoQA分数的94.0%,远高于其他所有方法. 在更低的30.0%时,MOOP的降解比其他方法要少得多,因为它是唯一一个推理不崩溃的方法. 删除93.75%的 MLP 专家通道将总参数减少率提高到39.4%,与 VLM 唯一 的 pruning 和 竞争性的 封闭- loop 性能相比,开放- roop 错误几乎保持不变 。 由此形成的模型实现了1.37x端到端的推论加速,比密集的模型降低了36.6%的峰值内存,没有后推的微调.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Reasoning vision–language–action (VLA) models for autonomous driving ( NVIDIA et al., 2025c ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ) extend action prediction with explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning ( Wei et al., 2022 ) to understand complex driving situations and explain driving decisions.
Alpamayo ( NVIDIA et al., 2025c ) , for example, conditions a flow-based ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) action expert on context from its backbone, which includes Chain-of-Causation (CoC) reasoning generated by a vision–language model (VLM).
Incorporating CoC in action denoising process improves trajectory prediction and closed-loop driving over a trajectory-only baseline, particularly in challenging scenarios ( NVIDIA et al., 2025c ) .
However, this procedure involves substantial computation: a large VLM generates CoC tokens autoregressively, and an action expert runs repeatedly to predict trajectories through iterative denoising.
As autonomous driving requires continuous action updates under rapidly changing scene conditions, this computational bottleneck presents a critical challenge for real-time deployment ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
自主驾驶的合理视觉-语言-行动(VLA)模式(NVIDIA等,2025c; 周克等,2025;傅克等,2025;袁克等,2026) 以明确的思维链(COT)推理(魏克等,2022)扩展动作预测,以理解复杂的驾驶情况并解释驾驶决定.
阿尔帕马约(NVIDIA等,2025c.),例如,基于流量的条件(Lipman等,2023年),行动专家从骨干的角度分析背景,其中包括由视觉-语言模型(VLM)生成的Causation链(CoC)推理.
将COC纳入行动去名化过程可以改善轨迹预测和闭路驾驶,特别是在具有挑战性的情况下(NVIDIA等,2025c)。
然而,这一程序涉及大量的计算:一个大型的VLM自动生成CoC符号,一个动作专家通过迭代去诺来反复运行来预测轨迹.
由于自主驾驶需要在迅速变化的场景条件下不断更新动作,这个计算瓶颈对实时部署提出了关键的挑战(Li等,2026年).

Figure 1: Overview of Mixture-of-Objective Pruning (MoOP). (a) Pruning the VLM with reasoning-driven (CE) importance alone preserves the CoC but degrades the predicted trajectory.
(b) Pruning with action-driven (FM) importance alone corrupts the reasoning that conditions the action expert.
(c) MoOP combines both objectives to select VLM units and uses FM importance to prune the action expert, preserving both reasoning and driving.
blocks.zh:
图1: " 目标组合 " 概览。 (a) 仅以推理驱动(CE)的重要性来运行VLM,保持CoC,但降低预测的轨迹。
(b) 仅仅靠行动驱动(FM)的重要性就破坏行动专家的推理。
(c) MOOP将目标结合起来,选择VLM单元,并利用FM重要性对行动专家进行定价,同时保留推理和驾驶。

blocks.en:
Structured model pruning offers a promising direction to reduce this cost by removing unnecessary parameters based on objective-driven importance scores ( Ma et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Muralidharan et al., 2024 ) .
However, applying structured pruning to reasoning VLA is particularly challenging.
Unlike standard VLM, reasoning VLA leverages a shared VLM backbone for two different roles ( i.e., scene-level CoC reasoning and action expert conditioning), while the action expert operates under different mechanism ( i.e ., iterative denoising steps).
Deciding what to prune thus requires assessing structural importance across both training objectives and architectural components.
blocks.zh:
结构化模型推敲为通过去除基于目标驱动的重要分数的不必要的参数来降低这一成本提供了一个有希望的方向(Ma等,2023;Li等,2025;Muralidharan等,2024)。
然而,将结构化的推论用于VLA尤其具有挑战性.
与标准VLM不同,推理VLA为两个不同角色(即场景级CoC推理和动作专家调制)利用了共享的VLM主干线,而动作专家在不同的机制下运行(即迭代去诺步骤).
因此,要决定什么是贫乏,就必须评估培训目标和建筑组成部分的结构重要性。

blocks.en:
To derive a tailored pruning strategy for reasoning VLA, we examine Alpamayo ( NVIDIA et al., 2025c ) , a representative VLA framework for autonomous driving that predicts trajectories along with CoC reasoning.
Specifically, we assess the importance of structural units for both reasoning and action predictions using Taylor importance ( Molchanov et al., 2017 ; Molchanov et al., 2019 ; LeCun et al., 1989 ; Hassibi et al., 1993 ) , which estimates the loss change induced by removing each unit.
We further analyze the distribution of importance scores within the action expert across iterative denoising steps, accounting for its distinct operating mechanism from the autoregressive VLM backbone.
blocks.zh:
为了为VLA推理得出一个量身定制的推跑策略,我们研究了阿尔帕马约(NVIDIA等,2025c),这是一个具有代表性的VLA自主驱动框架,它与CoC推理一起预测了轨迹.
具体地说,我们评估结构单元对于使用泰勒重要性进行推理和动作预测的重要性(Molchanov等,2017;Molchanov等,2019;LeCun等,2017. 1989年;Hassibi等人,1993年),它估计了通过去除每个单位而导致的损失变化。
我们进一步分析行动专家在迭代解码步骤中的重要性分数的分布情况,说明其不同于自递自转的VLM主干线的运作机制。

blocks.en:
Our analysis of the VLM backbone reveals that the parameters important for reasoning and those important for action generation are only partially aligned.
Thus, pruning based solely on a single objective leads to either CoC collapse or a sharp decline in action prediction, as described in Figure 1 .
These findings suggest that preserving both scene understanding and action generation requires accounting for both objectives during pruning, unlike existing single-objective pruning methods.
blocks.zh:
我们对VLM主干线的分析表明,对推理重要的参数和对行动产生重要的参数只是部分一致的.
因此,如图1所描述的,完全基于单一目标的挤压会导致CoC崩溃或动作预测急剧下降。
这些调查结果表明,与现有的单一目标探测方法不同,要保持对场景的理解和行动的产生,就需要在探测过程中对两个目标进行核算。

blocks.en:
For the action expert, parameter importance may vary across denoising steps.
We find that the importance of attention heads shifts with the step, whereas MLP channel importance remains nearly constant.
Moreover, while the importance score for Q-heads is broadly distributed, Figure 5(c) discloses that the top 10% of MLP channels account for approximately 98.2% of the measured importance.
blocks.zh:
对于行动专家来说,参数的重要性可能因取消提名的步骤而异。
我们发现,注意力的重要性随着步骤而转移,而MLP频道的重要性几乎保持不变。
此外,虽然Q-heads的重要性分数分布很广,但图5(c)披露,MLP频道的前10%约占所测重要性的98.2%。

blocks.en:
Motivated by these findings, we propose Mixture-of-Objective Pruning (MoOP), which jointly considers the dual objectives and the distinct architectural characteristics of both VLA modules.
For the VLM backbone, where the two objectives are only partially aligned, MoOP scores each unit by the maximum of its importance ranks under the two objectives and removes units critical to neither CoC reasoning nor trajectory generation.
In the action expert, MoOP instead prunes dense MLP channels that contribute little to prediction across denoising steps.
At a matched 24.0% total parameter reduction, MoOP matches or outperforms the compared methods on open- and closed-loop driving, and achieves the highest driving QA score by a large margin. At a higher reduction of 30.0%, the gap widens: MoOP is significantly better than all other methods in open-loop driving and the best in closed-loop driving.
With additional MLP-channel pruning in the action expert, the model reaches 39.4% total parameter reduction, a 1.37 × 1.37\times end-to-end inference speedup and 36.6% lower peak memory without post-pruning fine-tuning, while retaining competitive driving performance.
blocks.zh:
基于这些调查结果,我们提议 " 目标组合 " (MOOP),共同考虑两个 " 志愿行动 " 模块的双重目标和独特的建筑特点。
对于VLM主干线,在两个目标只有部分对齐的情况下,MOOP以两个目标下的最大重要性排名给每个单位打分,并去除对于CoC推理和轨迹生成都至关重要的单位.
在行动专家中,MOOP转而推开密密的MLP通道,这些渠道对跨去命名步骤的预测作用不大.
在匹配的24.0%总参数还原时,MoOP匹配或优于开行和闭行行驶的比对方法,以大比分达到最高的驾驶QA分. 如果降低30.0%,差距就会扩大: 与所有其他开闭式驾驶方式相比,MoOP明显优于其他所有开闭式驾驶方式,也优于开闭式驾驶方式.
在动作专家中附加了MLP-通道的穿透,该模型达到了39.4%的总参数还原率,一个1.37×1.37\时间的端到端推算速度和36.6%的低峰内存没有后推取微调,同时保留了有竞争力的驾驶性能.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows: • We demonstrate that VLM pruning must simultaneously account for both reasoning and action generation to preserve scene understanding and driving capability in reasoning VLA models. • We discover that a small subset of MLP channels in the action expert is sufficient to maintain robust action prediction quality. • We propose MoOP, the only compared pruning method that preserves reasoning, which keeps it robust at higher pruning ratios where existing methods degrade sharply.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下: 我们证明,VLM穿行必须同时兼顾推理和动作生成,以在推理VLA模型中保持场景理解和驱动能力. 我们发现,在行动专家中,微小的MLP渠道足以维持有力的行动预测质量。 我们提议MoOP,这是唯一比较的维持推理的方法,它保持了较高的推力比率,即现有方法急剧下降。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Reasoning Vision–Language–Action Models for Autonomous Driving. Driving VLAs connect scene understanding and language reasoning with action prediction. DriveVLM ( Tian et al., 2024 ) integrates scene analysis with hierarchical planning, while ORION ( Fu et al., 2025 ) conditions a generative planner on an LLM-generated planning token. AutoVLA ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) unifies reasoning and discrete actions within an autoregressive model. Alpamayo ( NVIDIA et al., 2025c ) generates Chain-of-Causation (CoC) reasoning and conditions a separate action expert on the VLM context to predict continuous trajectories.
We study how to prune this architecture while preserving its contributions to reasoning and trajectory prediction.
blocks.zh:
合理展望-语言-自主驾驶行动模式。 驾驶VLA将场景理解和语言推理与动作预测相接. 驱动VLM (Tian等,2024年)将场景分析与分级规划相融合,而ORION(Fu等,2025年)则在LLM生成的规划符上对基因规划者设置了条件. AutoVLA(周等,2025年)统一了自旋模式内的推理和离散动作. 阿尔帕马约(NVIDIA等,2025c)生成Causation链(CoC)推理和条件,一个单独的VLM背景动作专家来预测连续轨迹.
我们研究如何在保持其对推理和轨迹预测的贡献的同时,调整这一结构。

blocks.en:
Pruning Language and Vision-Language Models. Language-model pruning methods estimate importance through gradients or weight–activation statistics, as in LLM-Pruner ( Ma et al., 2023 ) and Wanda ( Sun et al., 2024 ) , and optimize layerwise sparsity allocation, as in Týr-the-Pruner ( Li et al., 2025 ) . For VLMs, SlimVLM ( Wen et al., 2026 ) accounts for visual-token redundancy and module sensitivity. Reasoning-aware approaches further adapt compression to the generation process: RAC ( Lucas et al., 2026 ) reconstructs activations from model-generated CoT ( Wei et al., 2022 ) traces, while MuCRASP ( Dutta & Aditya, 2026 ) considers reasoning-critical transitions and cross-modal alignment.
Our work examines a shared VLM that supports both textual reasoning and continuous action generation, combining importance measured under the two objectives.
blocks.zh:
普润语言与视野-语言模型. 语言模型推算方法通过梯度或重量-活性统计来估计重要性,如LLM-Pruner(Ma等,2023年)和Wanda(Sun等,2024年),并如Týr-the-Pruner(Li等,2025年)那样,优化了分层的伸缩分配。 对于VLMs,SlimVLM(Wen等,2026年)则说明可视化脚本冗余和模块敏感性. 理性意识方法进一步使压缩适应生成过程:RAC(Lucas等,2026年)从模型生成的COT(Wei等,2022年)中重建活化,而MUCRASP(Dutta & Aditya,2026年)则考虑推理关键过渡和跨模式对接.
我们的工作研究了一种共同的虚拟语言,这种语言既支持文字推理,又支持连续的行动生成,同时将两个目标下衡量的重要性结合起来。

blocks.en:
VLA Compression. VLA compression has explored structural pruning, quantization, and inference acceleration. For robotic manipulation, EfficientVLA ( Yang et al., 2025 ) combines layer pruning, token selection, and action-head caching; CLP ( Nguyen et al., 2026 ) removes redundant VLM and action-head layers before fine-tuning; and QVLA ( Xu et al., 2026 ) allocates channelwise precision using action sensitivity. In autonomous driving, Depth-Wise Probing and Pruning ( Babu et al., 2026 ) removes ORION decoder layers based on changes in the planning token, while FlashDrive ( Li et al., 2026 ) accelerates Alpamayo through caching and speculative decoding.
We combine CoC- and trajectory-based VLM pruning with action-expert MLP pruning guided by importance stability and concentration across denoising steps, without post-pruning fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
VLA 压缩. VLA压缩已经探索了结构推力,量化,和推论加速. 对于机器人操纵,"高效VLA"(Yang等,2025年)结合了地层回推,符号选择和动作头缓冲;CLP(Nguyen等,2026年)在微调前去除多余的VLM和动作头层;而QVLA(Xu等,2026年)利用动作灵敏度分配道道精度. 在自主驾驶中,深度-威斯探险和普鲁宁(Babu等,2026年)会根据规划符号的变化去除ORION解码器层;而FlashDrive(Li等,2026年)则会通过棺材和投机解码来加速阿尔帕马约.
我们把基于CoC和轨迹的VLM穿行与以重要稳定性和集中性为导向的MLP穿行相结合,不进行后穿行后微调。

blocks.en: 3.2 Structured Pruning and Taylor Importance
blocks.zh: 3.2 结构化普鲁宁和泰勒的重要性

blocks.en: Structured pruning. Structured pruning reduces model size by removing computational units with low estimated importance, together with their parameters ( Ma et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Muralidharan et al., 2024 ) . We prune two kinds of units, attention query heads and intermediate MLP channels, in both the VLM and the action expert. Removing query head u u deletes its d h d_{h} rows of W ℓ Q W^{\mathrm{Q}}_{\ell} and the matching columns of W ℓ O W^{\mathrm{O}}_{\ell} ; the key and value projections are kept, since several query heads share one KV head under grouped-query attention ( Ainslie et al., 2023 ) . blocks.en: Finding 1. CE and FM importance rankings diverge in the late VLM layers. Even for the same generated CoC tokens, the two objectives favor different units for reasoning generation and action conditioning.

blocks.en:
We first ask whether CE and FM importance identify the same VLM units for pruning. Within each layer, we compare the rankings induced by I CE I_{\mathrm{CE}} and I FM I_{\mathrm{FM}} using Spearman’s ρ \rho (Figure 3(a) ).
The rankings largely agree through layer 21 but diverge in later layers, suggesting that pruning with either objective alone can remove units important to the other. Figure 4(a) shows this comparison at the level of individual units.
The units of each layer are sorted by their I FM I_{\mathrm{FM}} rank, so each row of the I FM I_{\mathrm{FM}} panel changes smoothly from the most to the least important unit.
For both query heads and MLP channels, the I CE I_{\mathrm{CE}} panel departs from this order: units that I FM I_{\mathrm{FM}} ranks among the most important often receive low CE ranks, and vice versa.
To distinguish disagreement across token types from disagreement at the same tokens, we also compute importance separately for vision, prompt-text, generated-CoC and ego-history tokens by restricting the token-wise sum in the gate gradient (Eq. 2 ) to each token type before computing the Taylor importance score (Eq. 3 ). The resulting rankings agree more closely for vision tokens, especially through layer 21, whereas agreement for generated CoC tokens remains low across much of the backbone. Thus, the disagreement is not solely due to the two objectives drawing importance from different token types.

blocks.en: The persistent disagreement at generated CoC tokens reveals a further distinction between the objectives. The same unit outputs support next-token prediction under CE but provide conditioning information to the action expert through the KV cache under FM (Section 3.1 ). A unit needed to continue the reasoning sequence therefore need not be equally important for generating actions from that reasoning, and vice versa. CE and FM importance capture these different uses of the backbone, motivating a pruning criterion that accounts for both objectives.

blocks.en: 5 Method
blocks.zh: 5 方法

blocks.en:
Our approach uses CE and FM importance jointly to select VLM units and step-averaged FM importance to select action expert MLP channels.
In both components, selection is performed within each layer and unit type under a specified pruning budget. Applying the same pruning budget in every layer keeps comparisons focused on the scoring rule rather than on budget allocation. A non-uniform allocation guided by our analysis is explored in Appendix C.1 .

blocks.en: 5.2 Action Expert MLP Pruning
blocks.zh: 5.2 行动专家MLP 运行中

blocks.en: In the action expert, we prune intermediate MLP channels using FM importance. The CoC prediction loss depends on the VLM but not on the action expert parameters (Eq. 1 ), so expert pruning requires only the FM criterion. Because the expert reuses its weights throughout denoising, we score each channel using the step-averaged importance I ¯ FM ​ ( ℓ , u ) \bar{I}_{\mathrm{FM}}(\ell,u) in Eq. 4 . This score summarizes the estimated FM-loss sensitivity to removing a channel across the full denoising process. In practice, the choice of aggregation matters little. Using the score of any single denoising step instead yields nearly the same results (Appendix C.1 ), consistent with the stable rankings in Section 4.2 .
blocks.zh: 在行动专家中,我们使用调频重要度来推导MLP中间通道. CoC的预测损失取决于VLM,但并不取决于动作专家参数(Eq. 1),因此专家的打压只需要调频标准. 由于专家在整个解密过程中重用其权重,所以我们使用Eq. 4中I'FM(l,u)\bar{I}_{\-mathrm{FM}}(\ell,u)的分数来评分每个频道。 这一分数总结了估计FM-损失对清除整个去诺过程的通道的敏感性. 在实践中,汇总的选择不重要。 使用任何单一去名步骤的得分,结果几乎相同(附录C.1),与第4.2节的稳定排名一致。

blocks.en: 6.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en:
Implementation details. We prune Alpamayo-1.5-10B ( NVIDIA et al., 2025c ) using 100 calibration clips as illustrated in Section 4 , without post-pruning fine-tuning.
Our main setting applies a VLM pruning ratio of r = 0.4 r=0.4 in all 36 layers, removing 13 of 32 query heads and approximately 40 % 40\% of MLP channels, for 24.0 % 24.0\% total parameter reduction.
To test robustness under stronger compression, we also evaluate r = 0.5 r=0.5 , which removes half of the query heads and MLP channels in every VLM layer, for 30.0 % 30.0\% total reduction.
For the expert pruning process, we remove 93.75 % 93.75\% of MLP channels in each of its 36 layers, retaining 516 of 8,256 8{,}256 channels and all attention heads, for 39.4 % 39.4\% total reduction on top of r = 0.4 r=0.4 .
At each ratio, all compared methods remove the same fraction of parameters.
Details of the baseline methods are provided in Appendix A.2 .

blocks.en:
Evaluation protocol. Open-loop evaluation uses PhysicalAI-AV ( NVIDIA et al., 2025c ) Test500 and OOD-Val262, reporting the minimum average and final displacement errors over six 6.4 s trajectories (minADE@6 and minFDE@6, in meters). Closed-loop evaluation uses AlpaSim ( NVIDIA et al., 2025b ) Origin150 and Hard100, reporting route-progress scene score with off-road and at-fault collision penalties, and the rates of these failures. Driving VQA uses LingoQA ( Marcu et al., 2024 ) , reporting the percentage of answers accepted by Lingo-Judge. To measure how well CoC generation is retained, we also report the teacher-forced NLL of the CoC generated by the dense model on Test500 (CoC NLL). Higher scene score and Lingo-Judge score, and lower errors, failure rates, and CoC NLL, are better. Dataset construction and full protocols are in Appendix A.3 .
We compute 95% confidence intervals with a cluster bootstrap and call a difference between two methods significant when its paired 95% interval excludes zero (Appendix B.1 ).

blocks.en:
At 24.0 % 24.0\% parameter reduction, MoOP outperforms CE-only and FM-only on all four open-loop metrics and both closed-loop scene scores (Tables 1 and 2 ).
On Hard100, its scene score exceeds the two variants by 0.179 0.179 and 0.049 0.049 , respectively.
The improvement over CE-only is significant on both closed-loop sets, and that over FM-only is significant on Hard100 and over the combined 250 scenes (Appendix B.1 ).

Joint importance thus benefits both trajectory prediction and driving under closed-loop feedback.

blocks.en: MoOP exceeds CE-only and FM-only by 38.6 38.6 and 31.8 31.8 Lingo-Judge points, and the strongest external baseline, LLM-Pruner, by 24.0 24.0 points (Table 3 ). It remains 4.4 4.4 points below the dense model, a difference that is not significant, and achieves the lowest CoC NLL among the compressed models (Appendix B.1 ). The reasoning of the other methods, in contrast, collapses. A model that always answers “yes” already scores 37.6 37.6 on LingoQA. FM-only and Týr-the-Pruner are statistically indistinguishable from this answer, CE-only and Wanda fall significantly below it, and LLM-Pruner exceeds it by only 7.2 7.2 points. The baselines also fail on basic scene facts (Appendix D.1 ). FM-only, Týr-the-Pruner and CE-only state that there is no traffic light where MoOP reports its green state (Figure 8 ), and at a clear zebra crossing every compressed model except MoOP answers incorrectly (Figure 10 b). CE-only is a notable case: it keeps the second-lowest CoC NLL but fails on LingoQA, because its importance is calibrated only on CoC text and therefore preserves CoC generation rather than general scene understanding. These results support considering both objectives to preserve driving-scene understanding.

blocks.en: 6.3 Cost Analysis

blocks.en:
Combined pruning yields a 1.37 × 1.37\times end-to-end speedup and 36.6 % 36.6\% lower peak memory than the dense model (Table 4 ).
The two components contribute complementary savings.
VLM pruning provides most of the end-to-end speedup ( 1.30 × 1.30\times ), as it shortens prefill and autoregressive decoding, which dominate latency.
Expert pruning accelerates the denoising stage itself by 1.35 × 1.35\times ( 204.3 204.3 to 150.9 150.9 ms) and is essential for memory: it removes a further 1.71 1.71 B parameters and 3.19 3.19 GiB of peak memory, raising the peak-memory reduction from 22.4 % 22.4\% to 36.6 % 36.6\% .
This saving relies on the stable MLP rankings of Section 4.2 . If the rankings changed across denoising steps, each step would need its own set of channels and the expert would have to keep every channel selected at any step, whereas here a single pruned expert serves all steps.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We presented MoOP, a structured pruning method that accounts
for the roles of the VLM and action expert in reasoning VLAs.
Controlled comparisons show that using both reasoning and trajectory
importance better preserves driving QA, trajectory prediction,
and closed-loop scene scores than using either objective alone.
Among the compared pruning methods, MoOP is the only one that preserves
driving-scene reasoning, and its advantage in driving grows at a higher pruning ratio.
For the action expert, we exploit the stability and concentration
of MLP importance across denoising steps to identify channels for removal.
Together, the two components compress Alpamayo-1.5-10B without any
post-pruning fine-tuning: VLM pruning provides most of the inference speedup,
and expert pruning further reduces the memory footprint while leaving
driving performance largely unchanged.
The two findings that motivate MoOP also largely hold on Alpamayo 2 Edge
(Appendix C.3 ), suggesting that they are not specific to a single model.

blocks.en: A.4 Choice of Pruning Unit Types
blocks.zh: A.4 套接字单元类型的选择

blocks.en: Query heads and intermediate MLP channels define the granularity of pruning, that is, the type of unit that can be removed. We did not choose these unit types because they were estimated to be less important than other types, and we did not compare importance across unit types in advance. Importance is measured afterwards, only to decide which individual heads and channels to remove within each type. Likewise, other units, such as layers, hidden dimensions and KV heads, are kept not because they are more important, but because of the architecture.
blocks.zh: 查询头和中间的 MLP 通道定义了分流的颗粒性,即可以去除的单位类型. 我们之所以没有选择这些单位类型,是因为估计它们的重要性低于其他类型,而且我们没有事先对单位类型的重要性进行比较。 其后对重要性进行衡量,只是为了决定每一类型中应清除哪些主管和渠道。 同样地,其他单位,如地层,隐藏维度和KV头被保留,并不是因为它们更重要,而是因为建筑.

blocks.en: In Alpamayo ( NVIDIA et al., 2025c ) , each expert layer l l attends to the KV cache of VLM layer l l , which is how the VLM conditions action generation. Removing layers or hidden dimensions would break this layer-to-layer conditioning, and removing KV heads would remove part of the KV cache itself, which is shared by several query heads under grouped-query attention ( Ainslie et al., 2023 ) . Query heads and intermediate MLP channels, in contrast, can be removed without changing this interface. They are also the standard units in structured pruning of transformers ( Michel et al., 2019 ; Voita et al., 2019 ; Kwon et al., 2022 ; Ma et al., 2023 ; Muralidharan et al., 2024 ) . Removing them deletes entire rows and columns of the weight matrices, so the matrices simply become smaller. For example, removing an MLP channel deletes one row of the up and gate projections and one column of the down projection. Unlike removing individual weights, which leaves scattered zeros that standard hardware cannot skip efficiently, this yields real speedups without specialized sparse kernels.
blocks.zh: 在阿尔帕马约(NVIDIA等,2025c.)中,每个专家层ll处理VLM层l的KV缓存,这就是VLM如何条件动作生成. 移除地层或隐藏维度会打破这种地层到地层的调节,去掉KV头会去掉KV缓存本身的一部分,这在分组-query关注下由几个查询头共享(Ainslie等,2023年). 相形之下,查询头和中间的MLP通道可以在不改变这个接口的情况下被移除. 它们也是结构式推倒变压器的标准单位(Michel等,2019;Voita等,2019;Kwon等,2022;Ma等,2023;Muralidharan等,2024)。 删除它们会删除重量矩阵的整行和列,所以矩阵会变得更小. 例如,去除一个 MLP 通道删除了上行和出闸投影以及下行投影的一列. 与去除个别的权重(它留下了分散的零,标准硬件无法有效跳过)不同的是,这在没有专门的稀有内核的情况下产生出真正的快取.

blocks.en: We add 95% confidence intervals to the main tables in Section 6 . The intervals are percentile intervals from a cluster bootstrap, which resamples groups of correlated samples together rather than individual samples. For closed-loop evaluation (Tables 5 , 6 and 7 ), we resample scenes and keep both rollouts of a scene together, since they are strongly correlated (intraclass correlation 0.59–0.92; 100,000 100{,}000 resamples). For LingoQA evaluation (Tables 10 and 11 ), we resample the 100 segments and keep the five questions of each segment together. For open-loop evaluation (Tables 8 and 9 ) and CoC likelihood (Tables 10 and 11 ), we resample clips ( 200,000 200{,}000 resamples). All methods are evaluated on the same resamples, so differences between methods are paired, and we call a difference significant when its 95% paired interval excludes zero.

blocks.en: Because OOD-Val262 contains only 262 clips, we also evaluate open-loop prediction on OOD-train, the 1,271 OOD clips in the training split of the same OOD pool. These clips are disjoint from OOD-Val262 and from our calibration set but may have been seen by the base model, so this set measures how well each method retains the Baseline’s performance on long-tail scenarios rather than generalization to unseen data.

blocks.en: These tests support three conclusions. First, neither objective is sufficient on its own. MoOP is significantly better than CE-only on every benchmark, and significantly better than FM-only in reasoning, in long-tail (OOD) open-loop evaluation and in closed-loop evaluation over the combined scenes. Second, in open-loop evaluation, MoOP performs on par with the strongest pruning baseline on in-distribution data (Test500), and on long-tail (OOD) data it retains the performance of the dense Baseline significantly better than every other compressed method. Third, MoOP is the only compressed model that preserves reasoning. Its LingoQA accuracy is not significantly different from that of the dense Baseline, whereas every other compressed method loses at least 28 percentage points.

Our analysis, however, also suggests a non-uniform allocation. We base it on the CE–FM rank correlation computed on generated CoC tokens rather than on all tokens (Figure 3(a) ). Although the all-token correlation is high in the early layers, the CoC-token correlation remains low across much of the backbone, so units in the early and middle layers can also serve CoC generation and action conditioning differently. First, the CoC-token correlation fluctuates considerably between adjacent layers, which would cause abrupt changes in the pruning ratio between neighboring layers. Since such changes degrade performance ( Yin et al., 2024 ) , we scale the deviation by a = 0.25 a=0.25 , which limits it to at most 0.12 for query heads and 0.10 for MLP channels. Second, since the early layers are particularly sensitive to pruning ( Ma et al., 2023 ) , we keep the first i = 4 i=4 layers at the uniform ratio of 0.4. Query heads and MLP channels are allocated separately, units within each layer are still selected by the max-rank rule, and the total parameter reduction remains 39.4%, as in MoOP.

blocks.en: C.2 Ablation of the Combination Rule
blocks.zh: C.2 合并规则的违反

blocks.en: The max-rank rule does not weight the two objectives explicitly. This choice is deliberate, because the CE and FM importance scores have different scales: FM scores are on average about 1.6 × \times larger than CE scores. Since the max-rank rule operates on within-layer ranks, it is unaffected by this difference in scale, and it retains a unit if the unit ranks high under either objective. It also adapts to the rank correlation of each layer without a layer-specific weight. Where the two rankings agree, the combined score closely follows the shared ranking, and where they diverge, the top-ranked units under each objective are retained.
blocks.zh: 最高等级的规则没有明确强调这两个目标。 这一选择是刻意的,因为CE和FM重要分数的分数有不同的分数:FM分数平均比CE分数大约1.6×\分. 由于最高等级规则在等级内运作,因此不受这种规模差异的影响,如果单位在任一目标下排名高,则保留一个单位。 也适应了每层的分级关联,没有分层特定的分量. 在两个排名一致的情况下,合并分数紧密地跟随共享排名,在它们存在分歧的情况下,保留每个目标下排名最高的单位.

blocks.en: To test whether the raw scores can be combined directly, we compare max-rank with max-raw, which takes the maximum of the raw CE and FM importance scores and thus implicitly favors FM in proportion to its larger scale (Table 19 ). Max-raw gives a minADE@6 of 0.974 m on Test500 and 1.173 m on OOD-Val262 and a LingoQA accuracy of 59.2%, compared with 0.950 m, 1.119 m and 68.8% for max-rank.
blocks.zh: 为了测试原始分数能否直接合并,我们比较最大分数和最大分数,这需要原始分数CE和调频重要分数的最大分数,从而暗示倾向于调频与其更大分数的比例(表19). Max-raw给出了Test500上0.974米和OOD-Val262上1.173米的分母ADE@6和LingoQA的精度为59.2%,而最高排名为0.950米、1.119米和68.8%.

blocks.en: We also compare max-rank with the mean of the two ranks and with the mean of the raw importance scores. The two rank-based rules perform similarly, and their paired differences are not significant on any metric, whereas both rules that combine raw scores degrade reasoning. Letting the scale of one objective determine its priority is therefore harmful, which supports combining the objectives through their within-layer ranks.
blocks.zh: 我们还将最高排名与两个等级的平均值和原始重要性分数的平均值进行比较。 两种基于分级的规则运作类似,它们的配对差异在任何衡量尺度上都不显著,而两种将原始分数合并的规则都削弱了推理。 因此,让某一目标的规模决定其优先次序是有害的,它支持通过各级内部的级别来综合这些目标。

blocks.en: C.3 Generalization to Alpamayo 2 Edge
blocks.zh: C.3. 向阿尔帕马约的概况

blocks.en: To test whether the two findings that motivate MoOP hold beyond Alpamayo 1.5, we repeat both analyses of Section 4.1 and Section 4.2 on Alpamayo 2 Edge ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) , a compact model of the Alpamayo 2 family with 2.65B parameters. Its VLM pairs a SigLIP2 vision encoder with a 28-layer language model from the Cosmos 3 Edge backbone (16 query heads and 9,216 MLP channels per layer), and its 28-layer action expert (0.2B parameters) reads the VLM KV cache layer by layer and generates trajectories with ten flow-matching steps, as in Alpamayo 1.5. We use the same Calib100 clips, importance protocol and prompt as for Alpamayo 1.5. Both findings largely hold.
blocks.zh: 为了检验这两个结果是否超越了Alpamayo 1.5,我们重复了对Alpamayo 2 Edge(NVIDIA, 2026年)第4.1节和第4.2节的分析,这是Alpamayo 2家族具有2.65B参数的紧凑模型。 其VLM配对出自Cosmos 3 Edge主干线的一款28层语言模型的SigLIP2视觉编码器(每层16个查询头和9,216个MLP通道),其28层动作专家(0.2B参数)逐层读取了VLM KV缓存层并生成有10个流量相匹配步骤的轨迹,如阿尔帕马约1.5. 我们使用与阿尔帕马约1.5一样的 Calib100 剪辑, 重要协议和快速。 两项调查结果基本上都有效。

blocks.en: Unlike in Alpamayo 1.5, where the CE and FM rankings diverge mainly in the late layers, the all-token correlation of query heads in Alpamayo 2 Edge is already low in the early layers. In these layers, CE importance is concentrated on generated CoC tokens, whereas FM importance is concentrated on vision tokens (Figures 6(d) – 6(f) ). As in Alpamayo 1.5, however, the correlation computed on CoC tokens remains low across the backbone. blocks.en: In most cases, closed-loop evaluation faithfully scores the driving performance. In § D.4 , we discuss the exception we observed: scenes that admit more than one valid route.
blocks.zh: 在大多数情况下,闭路评价忠实地将驾驶性能评分. 在D.4节中,我们讨论了我们观察到的例外:允许不止一条有效路线的场景。

blocks.en: D.4 Multi-Answer Cases in Closed-Loop Evaluation
blocks.zh: D.4 闭环评价中的多答复案件

blocks.en:
As the examples in § D.3 show, the closed-loop score reflects driving quality in most scenes.
The exception we observed is the multi-answer case: a driving situation that admits more than one acceptable behavior, of which the protocol rewards only one.
At an intersection, for example, both turning and going straight can be valid.
Each closed-loop scene, however, has a single reference: the path the human driver took when the scene was recorded.
The model is given no navigation command, so nothing tells it which of the valid options that path follows.
AlpaSim ( NVIDIA et al., 2025b ) measures progress along the recorded path and stops scoring once the ego is more than 4 4 m from it.
A model that chooses a valid option other than the recorded one therefore receives a lower score than its driving warrants.
blocks.zh:
如§D.3中的例子所显示,闭路分数反映了大多数场景的驾驶质量.
我们观察到的例外是多答案例:一种驱动情况,它接纳了不止一种可接受的行为,协议只奖励其中一种行为.
例如,在一个相交点,转弯和直行都可以有效.
然而,每个闭路相片都有单一的参考: 人类司机在现场被录制时所走的道路.
该模型没有获得导航命令,所以没有任何信息可以告诉它路径所遵循的哪些有效选项.
AlpaSim(NVIDIA等,2025年b)测量所记录路径的进展,一旦自负超过4至4米就停止打分。
因此,选择有效选项而不是记录选项的模型得到的分数低于其驾驶证。

blocks.en: To quantify how often this occurs, we count a rollout as taking an alternative route when scoring stopped under the 4 m rule and the ego then continued for at least 10 m without any off-road event or collision. We also estimate the score lost to the rule for every rollout stopped by it, not only for those on alternative routes. The lost score is the additional progress score that the ego accrued along the reference route after scoring stopped, counted until the end of the rollout. Table 21 reports both quantities for each method.
blocks.zh: 为了量化这种情况的发生频率,我们计算出在4米规则下停止打分时采取替代路线,然后在没有任何越野事件或相撞的情况下,自负持续了至少10米。 我们还估计,每次推出时都会失去规则的分数,不仅是其他路线上的人。 失分是自负在积分停止后沿参考路线所积累的附加进度分数,计算到推出结束. 表21报告了每种方法的两种数量。

blocks.en: Table 21: Fraction of alternative routes and score lost to the 4 m rule.
blocks.zh: 表21:其他路线的分数和因4米规则而损失的分数。

blocks.en: The alternative-route fraction is similar across methods, at 5.0–8.0% on Origin150 (except 12.3% for CE-only) and 9.0–14.0% on Hard100, and its differences between MoOP and Týr-the-Pruner or LLM-Pruner are not significant. The score lost to the 4 m rule does not favor MoOP either. On Origin150, MoOP loses slightly more score to this rule (0.039 and 0.040 with expert pruning) than the Baseline, LLM-Pruner and Týr-the-Pruner (0.022–0.037), and on Hard100 the losses are similar (0.064–0.067 vs. 0.063–0.071). CE-only and FM-only lose more on Origin150 (0.083 and 0.045), but MoOP’s margins over them are much larger than these differences. Even if this progress were credited back to every method, MoOP would still achieve the highest scene score among the methods at the same budget on both sets (0.867 on Origin150 and 0.663 on Hard100). The route dependence therefore lowers absolute scene scores to a similar degree across methods and does not account for the differences between them.
blocks.zh: 替代路线的分数与不同方法类似,Origin150的分数为5.0-8.0%(CE-仅限12.3%除外),Hard100的分数为9.0-14.0%,而MoOP和Tír-the-Pruner或LLM-Pruner之间的差异并不明显。 输给4米规则的分数也不利于MOOP. 在Origin150上,MOOP对这个规则的分数(0.039和0.040加上专家打出)略高于基线,LLM-Pruner和Týr-the-Pruner(0.022-0.037),在Hard100上损失相近(0.064-0.067对0.063-0.071). 仅CE和FM在Origin150(0.083和0.045)上损失更多,但MOOP的比这些差异大得多. 即使将这一进展计入每一种方法,MOOP仍将在两套方法(Origin150版为0.867;Hard100版为0.663)的同一套预算中取得最高的场面分. 因此,路由依赖将不同方法的绝对场景分数降低到相近的地步,不计入它们之间的差异.
